name: Autumn Leaf Hot Air Balloons
description: Hot air balloons made of giant autumn leaves drifting over a misty forest.
prompt: A single dreamy autumn scene: several hot air balloons whose envelopes are made of giant translucent maple and oak leaves, floating over a misty forest in red, orange, and gold, baskets woven from twigs, soft morning light, distant river, birds, crisp fall atmosphere, highly detailed painterly style, no text, no logos, no watermarks.
caption: Fall’s official transport: leaf-powered balloons. 🍁🎈
